name: Adilabad Urban (derived built-up extent)
licence: derived from ESA WorldCover v200 (CC BY 4.0)
study_area_type: derived built-up settlement extent of Adilabad Town (the urban area of Adilabad Urban mandal and its adjoining built-up localities); the district of Adilabad is NOT the study area
boundary_type: DERIVED built-up settlement extent (NOT an administrative boundary)

derivation.raster: ESA WorldCover v200 (2021), 10 m, built-up class 50
derivation.window_m: 10 km x 10 km computation window around the centre (not the study area)
derivation.method: built-up cells closed over gaps <= 60 m, linked over gaps <= 250 m, clusters reaching within 1.5 km of the centre kept, outline smoothed; clipped only to the search area

covers.localities_source: Overture divisions points inside the polygon, release 2026-11-18.0

note: derived built-up settlement extent accepted by the owner (no official polygon available); centre = OpenStreetMap place node Adilabad (city)
